name: PDS Component Catalog
purpose: Product-neutral, agent-readable contract for framework-owned PDS Health component families.

packageContract.consumerBoundary: Products import the compiled package root or a public family subpath. Checkout-relative components/src imports and direct React Aria or AG Grid imports are not supported product contracts.

startHere: Read catalogManifest for family and component inventory.
Read componentSource for React APIs before creating product-local wrappers.
Use visibleCatalog for states, density, theme, and accessibility examples.
do: Use exported PDS components before introducing product-local controls.
Keep product routes, copy, data semantics, and workflow logic outside the shared package.
Bind generated model metadata, validation, request IDs, and correlation IDs through component props.
Preserve token-backed styling, keyboard behavior, focus management, and non-color status cues.
avoid: Do not copy reference fixture nouns into product scaffolds.
Do not fork admin UI or sample workflow screens into product frontends.
Do not add raw color literals to component CSS.
Do not claim a family is enterprise-ready without retained evidence.

apiContract.componentExportRule: Every framework-owned React component is a named export from components/src and has a matching <ComponentName>Props export.
agentUse: Use the component API inventory in the evidence artifact to find the source file and props type for a component.
Add new components to source, catalog.json, the visible catalog, and docs in the same change.
Do not introduce product-local controls while a matching PDS component family exists.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build a dense generated entity list with query controls, column control, density, loading, and pagination.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Columns, row routes, server query bindings, permission checks, persisted preferences, and row action meaning.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not create local table chrome or query buttons until the shared grid shell and controls are unsuitable and the exception is documented.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build a generated create or edit form with labels, hints, validation, lookup choices, and stable loading rhythm.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Generated field metadata, validation rules, submit behavior, save conflict handling, and workflow-specific copy.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not fork field wrappers or validation summaries when generated metadata can be bound through shared props.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build a destructive, policy-sensitive, or release-relevant action that needs confirmation and traceable feedback.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Action labels, authorization result, business consequence, confirmation copy, undo or compensation behavior, and recovery path.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not rely on color alone for danger or policy state, and do not bypass shared intent preview, confirmation, audit, undo, or compensation behavior.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build an operational dashboard with metric summaries, chart chrome, trends, empty states, and loading states.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Measures, calculations, chart renderer, thresholds, date-domain labels and density values, and data interpretation.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not put chart or date-domain semantics into the shared design system; keep shared components chart-engine-neutral and bind the adjustable range to product-owned data.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build a multi-step intake, approval, certification, or release workflow with visible progress and governed transitions.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Step labels, workflow ordering, branching rules, completion criteria, authorization, and transition side effects.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not hide blocked, optional, or skipped steps; expose current progress and governed transition feedback. Do not make only the marker or label selectable when the full step surface can be one native control.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build product navigation, page context, command access, and view switching with predictable keyboard behavior.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Route identity, navigation labels, selected view, user identity, role-aware visibility, URL behavior, and persisted appearance policy.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not copy admin UI navigation or reference screens into product scaffolds. Do not nest a secondary button inside a whole-card link or emulate navigation with a non-semantic click handler.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build an invoked AI answer surface that shows grounded messages, citations, confidence, tool status, entity refs, timeline, and graph context without granting write execution.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Prompt copy, model/gateway calls, answer-envelope data, retrieval policy, write-gate decisions, and product-specific graph content.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not present chat as write-capable; write-shaped actions must remain IntentPreview-only until G1 governed-write evidence and delegated auth exist.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build in-workflow AI-generated views, suggestions, cues, and summaries that are grounded, preview-gated, attributable, and non-disruptive.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Resolved refs, viewRegistry bindings, answer-envelope claims, assist-level behavior, memory storage/correction, policy decisions, and all write execution.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not render ungrounded suggestions, execute writes directly, or blend model-derived cues into deterministic facts without attribution.

agentDecisionGuide.intent: Build request-aware loading, empty, denied, error, success, warning, and retry feedback near the affected workflow.
agentDecisionGuide.productOwns: Error category, retry behavior, request and correlation identifiers, and support escalation path.
agentDecisionGuide.avoid: Do not hide request evidence in developer-only surfaces when the user needs recovery context.

maturityEvidence.note: PDS maturity reflects retained local/CI evidence (catalog manifest, visible catalog, token-backed CSS, accessibility patterns, consumer wiring). It is not live managed-environment certification; treat release-gated as 'evidence-backed pending live certification'.

versioning.policy: appfw_ui/pds_health/components is versioned with SemVer. Breaking component API or token-contract changes require a major bump; additive components/props a minor; fixes a patch. Components are deprecated for at least one minor release (status 'deprecated' with a replacement and removeBy) before removal.
versioning.deprecationPolicy: A deprecated component keeps working for at least one minor release, carries status 'deprecated' with 'replacement' and 'removeBy', and is announced in the CHANGELOG before removal in a major release.

rendererProjectionLedger.nonclaim: Native renderer source exists, but iOS and Android remain not-qualified until exact platform runtime, accessibility, visual, and compatibility evidence is retained.

families.name: Actions
families.purpose: Explicit commands, overflow actions, icon-only controls, and unified command access.

contract.props: variant, size, icon, loading, disabled, href, command items, intent changes, audit metadata, undo state
contract.states: quiet, secondary, primary, danger, loading, disabled, linked navigation, pending, approved, denied, undo available, compensation blocked
contract.density: small and medium controls use shared token sizing
contract.accessibility: native anchors for navigation, native buttons for commands, named icon actions, menu roles, disabled semantics, named intent review, live undo status
contract.usage: use ButtonLink for location changes, Button for commands, and governed-action primitives for write previews; keep product copy outside shared APIs
contract.verification: component checker, governed-action examples, consumer wiring, governed-write posture/evidence, agent harness profile

agentUse: Choose action components before adding product-local buttons, menus, or command search.
Keep labels, route targets, and permission decisions in product code.
Do not enable write execution from action primitives until G1 governed-write posture and live evidence are present for the provider and operation.
readiness.productBoundary: PDS owns action and navigation-control semantics, governed-action review surfaces, audit styling, and undo-state presentation; products own destinations, command meaning, labels, authorization, write execution, and compensation semantics. Live write execution requires G1 governed-write evidence and U2 agent-harness approval.

contract.states: valid, invalid, disabled, loading lookup, empty lookup, dirty form
contract.density: generated layouts use responsive fields and token spacing
contract.accessibility: labels, described-by, native inputs, alerts, switch roles
contract.usage: bind controls to generated field and validation contracts
contract.verification: form examples, generated frontend checks, browser form tests

agentUse: Choose form controls before creating product-local field wrappers.
Bind generated field metadata, validation, and relationship options through props.
readiness.productBoundary: PDS owns control semantics, focus, and validation presentation; products own data shape and workflow rules.

Keep column definitions, query bindings, and row routes product-owned.
readiness.productBoundary: PDS owns workspace chrome and query-control ergonomics; products own provider-backed data semantics.

families.name: Overlays

contract.props: open, title, description, size, side, tone, confirm actions

agentUse: Choose overlay shells before creating product-local modal, drawer, or popover behavior.
Keep destructive-action copy and workflow consequences product-owned.

families.name: Feedback

contract.props: kind, title, detail, typed operation state/result/request-correlation slots, metadata, retry actions, toast items
contract.states: idle, pending, loading, empty, denied, error, success, warning, info, cancelled
contract.density: inline and page-level feedback use shared rhythm
contract.accessibility: live regions, alert roles, status roles, keyboard-reachable actions, reduced-motion pending cues, request metadata near messages
contract.usage: keep users near the failed or blocked action with traceable IDs
contract.verification: feedback pattern checks and reference states

agentUse: Choose feedback primitives before creating product-local loading, empty, denied, or error states.
Expose request metadata near the affected workflow.
readiness.productBoundary: PDS owns feedback structure and live-region behavior; products own error categories and recovery actions.

families.name: Navigation
families.purpose: Application chrome, document-scrolling narrative and object-exploration workspaces, page structure, tabs, segmented controls, surfaces, and status badges.

contract.props: brand, appearance preference, nav items, label wrapping or intentional truncation, icons, trailing counts, optional adjustable sidebar bounds, document-scrolling narrative header/navigation/utility/context/footer slots, identity and avatar content, breadcrumb items, page title, exploration controls and named region slots, tabs, selected segment, whole-surface activation, queue status, surface actions
contract.states: system, light, dark, Apple-like, Material-like, current route or same-page mode, wrapped label, intentionally truncated label, overflow disclosure, pointer and keyboard resizing, responsive drawer, sticky narrative chrome, optional narrative context, bounded or flow exploration, optional navigator, inspector, controls, and evidence regions, breadcrumb location, selected tab, selected segment, selected card or row, completed, disabled, collapsed content
contract.density: expanded navigation uses a 14 px / 20 px semantic label role, a fixed 24 px icon column, a flexible two-line label column, non-shrinking trailing content, and shared responsive shell spacing; NarrativeWorkspace preserves document scrolling and a visible wrapping horizontal dock; bounded exploration gives its supplied regions independent scroll surfaces without expanding the page
contract.accessibility: named banner, primary navigation, main, narrative context, exploration, and breadcrumb landmarks; a narrative skip link and measured sticky offset; keyboard-focusable exploration scroll regions; current-page or pressed-mode semantics supplied by native product controls; complete accessible labels; overflow-only tooltip on hover and focus with Escape dismissal; an adjustable separator with value semantics and pointer plus keyboard operation; sibling secondary actions; tablist roles; pressed state; and focus rings
contract.usage: use NarrativeWorkspace for long-form knowledge experiences that need persistent horizontal mode navigation and one document scroll owner; products supply route or mode identity, destinations, activation commands, app-specific labels, role visibility, counts, identity values, sidebar persistence key, narrative context, exploration objects, access and selection state, evidence, status meaning, and secondary-action consequences; PDS owns readable wrapping, exceptional overflow disclosure, icon geometry, resize mechanics, responsive collapse, narrative sticky geometry, and exploration-region layout
contract.verification: catalog coverage at 240, 288, and 360 px sidebar widths; document-scrolling narrative desktop/narrow/print layouts; sticky offset and unobscured focus; wrapped and intentionally truncated labels; one-, two-, and three-region exploration; bounded desktop and flow-based narrow/print exploration; Apple-like and Material-like light/dark themes; pointer and keyboard resizing; independent keyboard scrolling; overflow tooltip behavior; 200% zoom; mobile drawer; scaffold residue checks

agentUse: Choose shell, narrative or exploration workspace, header, surface, tab, and segmented controls before building product-local navigation chrome, long-form knowledge layouts, or dense object-exploration layouts.
Keep route identity and workflow labels product-owned.
readiness.productBoundary: PDS owns appearance state propagation, semantic navigation typography, icon geometry, two-line wrapping, exceptional overflow disclosure, adjustable-sidebar mechanics, responsive collapse, narrative sticky-header/dock geometry and landmarks, identity composition, navigation structure, exploration-region landmarks and responsive layout, whole-surface activation semantics, queue-row composition, and selected-state treatment; products own routing or same-page mode semantics, information architecture, copy, context meaning, content anchors, focus restoration, object semantics, access, selection, filtering, relationships, evidence and proof, role visibility, counts, identity data, persistence keys, status meaning, and action consequences.

contract.states: user, assistant, system, tool, streaming, busy, queued, running, blocked, completed, failed, high confidence, policy warning
